description: LiteLLM proxy metrics dashboard — token usage, costs, latency, and HTTP server health

data_source.query:
TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm" AND gen_ai.client.token.usage IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Total LLM Requests` = COUNT(TO_TDIGEST(gen_ai.client.token.usage))

TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm"
| STATS `Total Token Usage` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(to_tdigest(gen_ai.client.token.usage)))

TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm" AND attributes.gen_ai.token.type == "input"
| STATS `Total input tokens` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(to_tdigest(gen_ai.client.token.usage)))

TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm" AND gen_ai.token.type == "output"
| STATS `Total output tokens` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(to_tdigest(gen_ai.client.token.usage)))

TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm"
| STATS `Total LLM cost in USD` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(TO_TDIGEST(gen_ai.client.token.cost)))

TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm"
| STATS `Active HTTP Server Requests` = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(http.server.active_requests))

config.title: Token Usage Over Time (1-Minute Buckets) — litellm

data_source.query:
TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm"
| STATS `Token Usage` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(to_tdigest(gen_ai.client.token.usage))) BY `Time Bucket` = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| SORT `Time Bucket`

config.title: Input vs Output Token Usage Over Time by Token Type (1-min buckets)

data_source.query:
TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm"
| STATS `Input vs Output Token Usage` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(to_tdigest(gen_ai.client.token.usage))) BY `Token Type` = gen_ai.token.type, `Time Bucket` = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| SORT `Time Bucket`, `Token Type`

config.title: Token Usage Over Time by Model

data_source.query:
TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm"
| STATS `Token Usage` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(to_tdigest(gen_ai.client.token.usage))) BY `Model` = gen_ai.request.model, `Time` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT `Time`, `Model`

TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm"
| STATS `Token Usage` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(to_tdigest(gen_ai.client.token.usage))) BY `Model` = gen_ai.request.model
| SORT `Token Usage` DESC

TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm"
| STATS `Token Usage` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(to_tdigest(gen_ai.client.token.usage))) BY `AI System` = gen_ai.system
| SORT `Token Usage` DESC

TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm"
| STATS `LLM Cost` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(TO_TDIGEST(gen_ai.client.token.cost))) BY `Time Bucket` = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| SORT `Time Bucket`

config.title: Total Token Usage by Top 10 Users

data_source.query:
TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm"
| STATS `Total Token Usage` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(to_tdigest(gen_ai.client.token.usage))) BY `metadata.user_api_key_user_id`
| SORT `Total Token Usage` DESC
| LIMIT 10

TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm"
| STATS `Total Token Usage` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(to_tdigest(gen_ai.client.token.usage))) BY `metadata.user_api_key_team_id`
| SORT `Total Token Usage` DESC
| LIMIT 100

config.title: Average Response Duration Over Time – LiteLLM (1-minute buckets)

data_source.query:
TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm"
| STATS `Average Response Duration` = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(TO_TDIGEST(gen_ai.client.response.duration))) BY `Time Bucket` = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| SORT `Time Bucket`

data_source.query:

| SORT `Time Bucket`

config.title: Average Time Per Output Token Over Time (litellm)

config.title: Average Response Duration by Model (per minute) — LiteLLM

data_source.query:
TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm"
| STATS `Average Response Duration` = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(TO_TDIGEST(gen_ai.client.response.duration))) BY `Model` = gen_ai.request.model, `Time Bucket` = TBUCKET(1 minute)

config.title: Top Models by Total Token Usage — LiteLLM

data_source.query:
TS metrics-generic.otel-default
| WHERE service.name == "litellm"
| STATS `Total Token Usage` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(to_tdigest(gen_ai.client.token.usage))) BY gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.system, gen_ai.operation.name
| SORT `Total Token Usage` DESC
